english.title: Drivers hours - cause driver to fail to take minimum daily rest in 24 hour period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), not to have a daily rest period of at least

(A)_[eleven]_
(B)_[nine]_
(C)_[twelve hours in total including a period of at least nine]_

consecutive hours in contravention of Article 8(1) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused the driver of a motor vehicle
to fail to take daily rest period of at least nine/eleven/twelve hours in total

english.notes:
(i) See Article 8(1) for circumstances in which the rest period may be reduced.
(ii) Where the place of the offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H2633 and H3171.

(B)_[nine]_
(C)_[twelve hours in total including a period of at least nine]_

consecutive hours.
